proof_packet.title: Formalize the acknowledged Frobenius factorization separability guard
proof_packet.body:
The downloaded Galbraith9.6.18 puts the factorization separability condition onpsi. The author's errata moves it toPHI and credits Pierre Chretien. This change formalizes the acknowledged correction's counterexample over every actual finite-field elliptic model, in an explicit actual-function-field/rational-coordinate formulation. No novelty or corrected-general-theorem refutation is claimed. [pcc:unverified]

Actual geometric q-Frobenius is bijective with trivial kernel, so kernel(phi)subsetkernel(identitypsi), and identitypsi is separable. Actual field Frobenius has no right inverse: the actual infinity parameter has order1 and cannot be a qth power. Lean proves the actual image extension purely inseparable/nonseparable, plus coordinate localization and actual genericpoint x/y naturality. Thus the correctedPHI guard excludes the example. Geometric kernels are distinct from scheme kernels; a separate Scheme/isogeny-category API comparison and general corrected factorization/Weil nondegeneracy remain open. Healthy identity/Frobenius-square and actual F2/F3 controls pass. [pcc:unverified]
